answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. A farm faking 532 aliases needs 532 separate watch logs, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Coastguard auxiliary tenure with station watch logs is the check: watches kept at one station across many years. Watch the meadow: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the willow bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the bridge audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
